Method. Total MtM = MV now − (additions − withdrawals), external cash transfers only (from the 3R transaction reports; in-kind transfer to Antarras is not a flow). MtM % is on total additions; Ann. is the money-weighted IRR. YTD = MV now − MV at 31.12.2025 − net flows since (approx.: start value rebuilt from transactions and 31.12.2025 closes, ±2%); % = Modified Dietz, GEM to its Oct-2026 liquidation. TWR = time-weighted return: value rebuilt from the transactions just before every flow, sub-period returns chained, last period to the current MV (updates on every refresh while there are no new flows); GEM stops at liquidation; TWR ann. compounds it from inception; IRR ann. is the money-weighted return. Initial = first cash inflow. Withdrawals include the GEM liquidation transfers (Oct-2026) and the EVO withdrawal (Jul-2026); US Equity income received $0.8M new money in Aug-2026. Cash returned from the old JPM accounts after the transfer (dividends, residual cash) counts as income, not as a flow. GEM inception = first cash inflow (mandate opened ~1 month earlier).

Thematic Investments

% of gross liquid assets (financial assets, cash incl.; private markets & short-option liability excluded) · each position sits in one theme · click a theme to list its instruments
Base: gross liquid assets $163.8M in 30 themes (bonds, bond ETFs, equities, equity ETFs, JPM modules and cash; private markets, loans and the short-option liability are not included). Themes are a partition: every position is placed in one theme, and funds with a mixed mandate are split by weight (a % tag marks the share of the position that sits in the theme), so the rows add up to gross. Cash theme = bank cash, money-market funds, T-bills and short sovereign bills ($27.7M, 14 lines).
MtM = mark-to-market result vs cost, from the Bonds / Equity tables (position MtM % and $; bond $ is derived from MtM % and market value, cost = MV / (1 + MtM %)). It excludes dividends, coupons and other income, so it is not the total return of a position. Split positions pro rata; cash has no MtM. Theme MtM % = MtM / cost of its positions. All themes: -1.07M on cost $137.2M. YTD % = year-to-date return of each position (xlsx 'Position YTD Performance'; JPM modules from the YTD price file); theme YTD % is weighted by the value at the start of the year of the positions that have a YTD figure (18 position(s) have none: '–', excluded). Positions bought during 2026 are measured from their purchase / first price in the source data.
Split weights: judgment (editable in theme_rules.json) — AIPO 50% AI infrastructure & semiconductors / 50% Utilities & power; PHP 50% UK REITs / 50% Healthcare & biotech; data-based from top-10 holdings — XDWM: gold=sum(Newmont,Agnico)/100, copper=Freeport/100, rest materials; IDKO: memory/semis=sum(Samsung 005930/005935, SK hynix 000660, Samsung EM 009150)/100, rest regional. Top-10 holdings of some ETFs are dated (see Equity page).
Short-option notional by theme (hidden long exposure, not in the figures above): Crypto / digital assets $2.19M, AI infrastructure $0.68M, Memory cycle $0.65M, Quantum computing $0.40M, Nuclear / uranium $0.24M — total $4.16M.
5 position(s) without a theme rule are listed under "Unassigned (no theme rule)" — add them to theme_rules.json.
